content:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFILE
Butcher and meat-counter professional with experience since 2015 in carcass breakdown, customer service and food hygiene. Skilled in cutting and portioning beef, pork and lamb, making fresh sausages, rotating stock using FIFO, and recording cold-chain temperature checks. Friendly and knowledgeable when advising customers on cuts and cooking methods.

EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante, Zagreb | 2019–present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides each week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Prepare four kinds of fresh sausage to the shop’s recipes, including ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez; produce about 40 kg per week in the busy season.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix following customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair in 2023.
- Rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, keeping the oldest products at the front.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily.
- Serve around 120 customers on a Saturday and advise on cuts, quantities and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in safe knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting at weddings and family events, including a 180-guest wedding order in 2024.
- Ran a six-week dry-ageing trial for beef ribs, recording temperature and weight loss; dry-aged rib is now sold by pre-order.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac Meat Hall Stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at close.
- Created a closing and cleaning checklist after a hygiene inspection remark; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher examination (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027; not yet passed

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning and trimming · Meat cutting and portioning · Fresh sausage making · FIFO stock rotation · HACCP food hygiene · Cold-chain temperature checks and records · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · Customer service and advice · Cash handling

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good, customer-facing) · German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, highly relevant CV for the advertised role. It is clear, professional and well structured, with a concise profile, reverse-chronological experience, relevant training, skills and languages. The quantified evidence—carcass volumes, sausage production, customer volume, temperature checks and the 180-guest wedding order—makes the experience credible and impactful. The CV also demonstrates the employer's stated priorities: customer advice, hygiene, FIFO stock rotation, practical ability and pride in product quality. The dry-ageing and sausage-development examples add useful evidence of initiative without distracting from the core butcher role. The planned Master Butcher examination is presented transparently as not yet passed, which is appropriate.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is excellent. The document uses standard section headings, plain text, conventional date and employment formatting, bullet points and relevant keywords such as butcher, meat counter, carcass breakdown, beef, pork, lamb, boning, trimming, portioning, fresh sausage, FIFO, HACCP, temperature checks, customer service and cash handling. It contains no tables, graphics, text boxes, icons or unusual formatting likely to interfere with parsing. AI screening probability is high because the document directly demonstrates both mandatory requirements and closely matches the wording of the role. A minor improvement would be to include the exact target title near the candidate's name so the intended role is immediately identifiable.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV is an excellent match. Completed butcher training is clearly shown, as is substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience. HACCP knowledge is supported by the certificate, temperature records and hygiene-related work. The document also matches the main duties: cutting and portioning fresh meat, advising customers, rotating stock using FIFO, and recording temperature checks. The customer-facing evidence aligns well with FreshCart's emphasis on knowledgeable and helpful counter staff. The candidate does not have a forklift licence, so that nice-to-have requirement is a genuine gap, but it is not a defect in the CV and should not be implied. No unsupported supermarket, self-service packaging or forklift experience has been added.
critique.improvement_instructions: MINOR ENHANCEMENT: At the top of the CV, directly below “Tomislav Mesarić,” add the targeted headline “Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant.” This uses the advertised job title, improves immediate recruiter recognition and gives ATS systems an exact title match without adding any unsupported qualification or experience.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or at least 2 years at a meat counter
